structure.unit: Motor Vehicle Fuels Sales Tax in Certain Transportation Districts

text.section:
A person who knowingly commits any of the following acts is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor:
Dispenses into the supply tank of a highway vehicle, watercraft, or aircraft any fuel on which a tax required to be levied under this chapter has not been paid; or
Allows to be dispensed into the supply tank of a highway vehicle, watercraft, or aircraft any fuel on which a tax required to be levied under this chapter has not been paid.
